technology_name: A MULTI-FUNCTIONAL RECONFIGURABLE PROTECTION DEVICE AND METHOD OF OPERATING THE SAME
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Modular Structural Shell / Reconfigurable Defense Tool
problem_solved: Standard perimeter shield walls and emergency shelter dividers use completely rigid, heavy structures that demand intensive site transport labor and lack deployment flexibility against dynamic environmental threats.
description: A portable modular protective panel device designed around an origami-inspired folding frame configuration, driven via localized actuator components and a central microcontroller box to rapidly transition between defensive arrays.
applications: Rapid deployment field shelters, smart city emergency barricades, modular military outpost partitions, and disaster relief camp zoning.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities, Digital Technologies, AI & Software
